children.description: Description. Herbs perennial, rosette when young and stem obviously elongated after years of growth. Stem fleshy, cylindrical, 6 - 30 cm long, 4 - 6 mm in diameter, densely white pubescent when young, but glabrescent to glabrous when aging. Leaves alternate on elongated aerial stem, 12 - 20 cm or more, nearly clustered near the top of the stem and look opposite. Petiole 4 - 8.5 cm long, 3 - 3.5 mm in diameter, densely white pubescent.
